It's not my favorite subject, but I understand its importance and try to engage with it when necessary.

To find the stationary points of a function y = f(x), you first need to find its derivative, f'(x). Then, set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. The solutions will give you the x-coordinates of the stationary points. To determine whether they are maxima or minima, you can use the second derivative test.
